name: Milgram
source:
An infamous Necromancer and menace to society. The highest bounty in human history has been placed on his head.

Proponent of the Antibiotic Front and spiritual leader of the Suicide Wannabes.

Leads an elite group of Necromancers known as The Laboratory.

[Spoiler]Resurrected [url=/c165928]Nagaoka Sakiko[/url] as a living dead at [url=/c165927]Nagaoka Takeyuki's[/url] behest.[/spoiler] 

[From the in-game profile]
